identification: Cased figural meerschaum pipe, two galloping horses carved along the shank, amber-type bowl collar, white metal band, black stem, fitted leather case with red velvet and silk. Probably late 19th to early 20th century continental (Austrian/Turkish trade). No maker mark visible. Carving looks intact in photos.

viewing_check: Check the carving for cracks, repairs or chips (horse legs and ears), whether the white metal band has hallmarks, whether the amber collar is real amber or plastic, any maker or retailer stamp inside the case lid or on the shank, and whether the bowl is true meerschaum (light, porous) rather than moulded composite.
